name: h5a-long
hypothesis: H5a policies were still improving at 2M steps (best checkpoint = last step in 9/10 runs). Continuing each energy-weight-4 seed for 2M more PPO steps lowers DVR further.
threshold: Per seed the checkpoint is chosen on the 20-episode validation subset, where step 0 is the H5a policy, so a seed can keep its old policy. Report evaluation-v21 paired vs SHORTEST_FINISH+EDF+NONE and vs the H5a result; contribution criterion as PLAN_HUONG_2_3.md 7.4.
